name: Kazama Kippei
source:
Homura's best friend.

Backpack: he can save a maximum of 6 items.

Fears: spirits.

[spoiler]He likes Yachika. He will enter in 'desperation mode' if he watches Yachika's corpse.[/spoiler]

Family: father; mother; little sister (6 years).
